verdict.rationale: Apify supports scheduling Actors/tasks at specific times (apify-docs-6, apify-docs-35), webhooks that trigger new Actor runs on completion/failure (apify-docs-14, apify-docs-29), monitoring/alerting for runs (apify-docs-7), and MCP/agent integration for autonomous use by AI agents (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3) — together enabling background, autonomous automation pipelines. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating scheduled or webhook-triggered runs working reliably in production, and no explicit end-to-end example combining scheduling+webhooks+monitoring into one autonomous pipeline.
